notes: Both demonstrative phrases (those cities, that city) give the written determiner to the demonstrative pronoun and leave the noun's article and the agreement article unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
In the entrance of the gate of the city the rectum is rendered arthrously, so nothing is fronted: הָ takes the the standing before city and the two outer constructs take supplied the's (rule 29).
The margin's 'Hebrew gather' for take was read and set aside (rule 38).
The final waw takes the connective that the ASV wrote for it (rule 14); the directive he takes into (rule 32) beside the article's own the.
